license.label: CC Attribution

assets.description: A massive humanoid creature made of dark stone, with glowing lava cracks running across its body. Broad shoulders and thick, powerful arms end in rock-like claws with glowing red tips. The head is small and angular, carved from stone, with fiery eye sockets. Sharp, jagged stone and lava formations protrude from the shoulders and back. Legs are thick and sturdy, feet like molten rock slabs. The overall impression is immense, threatening, and volcanic, like a living golem born from fire and magma.
